content.snl: enumerate(%Current baseline: explicit Style selection and legacy/default fallback. Planned 0.3.4 adds conservative exact-slot inference without changing the AST or Macro query contract; implementation is not verified.%,ts.ellipsis@spec.rv.automatic-style-selection-034)
content.markdown: At the 0.3.3 baseline, `resolveStyle` validates Macro templates, honors an explicit `node.style_name`, and otherwise uses the deprecated runtime `default_style` language/English mapping or `styles[0]`; unknown selected names remain errors. Planned 0.3.4: when no explicit selector or legacy map applies, select the first eligible fixed-arity text/formula Style whose exact referenced positional-slot set equals the filled-child-slot set. Eligibility examines every locale and excludes block/SVG/custom and opaque consumer-owned templates. No exact match or dynamic arity keeps the old fallback. Locale projection stays within the selected Style; no AST, query signature or cache mutation is permitted. See `spec.rv.automatic-style-selection-034` for the complete normative contract and unexecuted acceptance matrix. This is planned behavior, not verified implementation.
